title: CJP protest in Delhi LIVE: Team Dipke says will spend night at Jantar Mantar despite no nod for protest
description: CJP protest in Delhi LIVE: Abhijeet Dipke issued an appeal to parents to reach Jantar Mantar by 6pm and seek Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation as education minister. However, he later said that cops were “not taking his calls” seeking to extend the protest.
